hooks.name: Pre-release security review nudge
hooks.description: Nudges the agent to run the relevant security playbooks and checks whenever the user signals they're about to commit, submit, or deploy.
hooks.matcher: (?i)(ready to (commit|submit|deploy|ship)|about to (deploy|release|submit)|before (the )?(hackathon|demo|release|deadline)|final check|is this safe to (push|commit|submit|deploy))

action.prompt: The user signaled they are about to commit, submit, or deploy. Before helping with anything else, run a pre-release security pass: look at what changed (git diff / recently touched files), decide which security playbooks under .kiro/steering/security/ are relevant (use disclose_context to load each relevant one by name), run the matching scripts in scripts/ for anything that has one (gitleaks via audit-existing-repo.sh, pip-audit/npm audit, semgrep, iac-scan.sh, container-scan.sh, headers-check.sh), and report findings grouped by severity before proceeding. If nothing relevant changed, say so briefly and continue normally.
